title: policy-gap-matrix
description: Structured gap matrix produced by the policy-gap-review skill. The matrix carries one row per gap between a firm policy and a named, dated benchmark of obligations or supervisory expectations. Foundational primitive consumed by issue-writeup (rows whose severity warrants tracking as findings), obligation-mapping (rows whose linked_obligation_ids is empty and which imply an obligation the register did not yet carry), control-matrix (rows whose gap has an operational dimension), and evidence-binder (evidence_needed asks). Stable contract: additive changes only between minor versions; breaking changes ship as a versioned migration.

review_id.description: Stable identifier for this review instance. Reused across revisions of the same review.

as_of_date.description: Date the review was last revised.

engagement_id.description: Foreign key into scope.schema.json when the review was built under a formal scope.

policy_name.description: Named policy or set under review. Where a set, name the primary; supporting standards land in supporting_artefacts.

policy_version.description: Version label as the firm uses it (e.g., v6.1, 2025-Q1).

owner_role.description: Named role accountable for the policy. Generic labels are insufficient.

document_identifier.description: Internal doc ID, GRC platform record, or intranet URL.

supporting_artefacts.description: Supporting standards or procedures that fall in scope of the review alongside the primary policy.

source_name.description: Named benchmark (e.g., 'OCC Bulletin 2026-13', 'Interagency Guidance on Third-Party Relationships (June 2023)', 'NIST AI RMF 1.0').

section_references.description: Section references actually used as benchmark in this review. Use [verify section] in references/source-anchors.md when the exact reference is not yet confirmed; do not invent section labels.

obligation_register_ref.description: Foreign key into obligation-register.schema.json when the benchmark is an obligation register rather than the underlying source.

benchmark_sources.description: The benchmark list. A review without at least one named, dated benchmark with section references is internal-consistency editing, not a gap review.

policy_section.description: Section or heading of the policy actually read against the benchmark.

benchmark_sources_used.description: Names of benchmark sources used for this section.

scope_of_review.description: Sections of the policy in scope of this review. Sections outside this list are not silently assumed compliant.

source_posture.description: public-only: the matrix carries the policy text and the benchmark, no firm operational evidence. firm-policy-overlay: firm policies and standards augment the benchmark set. mixed: both, with named seams.

gap_id.description: Stable identifier scoped to this matrix. Downstream issue-writeup, obligation-mapping, and control-matrix consumers key off this ID.

benchmark_requirement.description: One sentence stating what the benchmark requires. Paraphrase preserves the operative verb and operative object.

policy_text_excerpt.description: Policy text on the topic. Verbatim where the wording is at issue; paraphrased where the issue is silence or scope. Where the policy is silent, value reads 'policy is silent'.

policy_location.description: Section number or heading in the policy. Where the policy is silent, value names the section the topic should sit under.

gap_classification.description: missing: policy does not address the requirement at all. partial: addresses some but stops short. weak: addresses at lower rigor than the benchmark expects. inconsistent: contradicts the benchmark or another firm policy. outdated: reflects a prior edition of the benchmark.

severity.description: Severity rating. Always carries human review; unattested severity is a proposal, not a rating.

severity_rationale.description: References materiality (against firm thresholds where they exist), supervisory exposure, customer impact, operational risk, and compensating practice. Severity without rationale is opinion.

compensating_practice.description: Operational practice (not a policy fix) that reduces the practical exposure pending the policy edit. 'none' or omitted when there is no compensating practice.

recommended_edit.description: Declarative voice. What the policy should say, summary-drafted to a level the policy author can work from.

evidence_needed.description: Operational artefacts beyond the text edit: standards updates, training, workflow changes, attestations. Mandatory on rows classified partial, weak, inconsistent, or outdated.

linked_obligation_ids.description: Foreign keys into obligation.schema.json. Empty when the obligation register did not yet carry the obligation; the empty array routes a back-reference into obligation-mapping rather than fabricating an ID.

linked_control_ids.description: Foreign keys into control.schema.json. Empty when the gap is purely textual; populated when the gap has a control dimension.

owner_role.description: Named role accountable for the policy section. 'Compliance' is not an owner; firm-specific role labels live in references/firm-overlay.md.

row_confidence.description: Per-row confidence where the practitioner is reading between the lines or relying on a single secondary source. Optional; matrix-level confidence covers the default case.

gaps.description: The matrix rows. Order in the structured record does not bind the surface artifact's sequencing; a sign-off pack may sequence by severity, by policy section, or by benchmark source depending on audience.

total_benchmark_items.description: Total benchmark requirements in scope of this review.

covered_items.description: Benchmark requirements the policy covers in full.

coverage_summary.description: Integer counts. Percentages are derived for the surface artifact; the structured record carries counts.

item.description: Benchmark item the firm deliberately does not cover.

rationale.description: Why the firm does not cover the item. Threshold not met, institution-type exemption, deferred effective date, etc.

out_of_scope_items.description: Audit-defence artefact. Reconstructed rationale is harder than written rationale.

other_policy.description: Named other firm policy this gap interacts with.

linked_gap_ids.description: Gap IDs in this matrix involved in the cross-policy interaction.

cross_policy_interactions.description: Most material gaps interact with at least one other firm policy. Burying the interaction in commentary breaks the firm's overall governance architecture.

recommended_next_steps.description: Operational next steps: draft revisions for legal review, route to committee, schedule working session, schedule training refresh.

confidence_label.description: Author's confidence in the matrix as a whole. Per-row confidence available where the practitioner is reading between the lines.

reviewer_questions.description: Questions for the human reviewer at sign-off. Specific to this matrix; tied to a named gap, classification, severity rating, or cross-policy interaction.

human_review_required.description: Always true. The skill stops at draft; severity assignment always carries human review.
